summary: Retested the edit-external-url flow in EditModal.jsx (iteration_14 HIGH regression). Backend (2 curl PUTs) + Frontend Playwright covered: field renders with correct testid + initial value, save-persists via /api/tours, public /tours card href updates, empty-string clear removes public link, kind-guard hides field on Rentals & Taxi Services modals. Blue Lagoon restored to original state (external_booking_url, price=89, duration='6 hours', location='Departs Nassau Harbour').
critical_code_review_comments: EditModal save() rebuilds payload from scratch which means fields NOT included per kind (e.g. taxi payload omits external_booking_url) — that's fine because backend model_dump filters None; verified by curl empty-string test also. No action needed.
Backend PUT accepts arbitrary price mutations without validation — outside scope but noted (price_history correctly logged during test).
seed_data_creation: None. Modified Blue Lagoon tour external_booking_url during test and fully restored to seed values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_14 HIGH bug (missing edit-external-url field + null-vs-empty clear semantics) is fully fixed. Blue Lagoon tour left in original state. Test coverage: set new URL → persist reopen → verify public href → clear (empty string) → verify public link hidden → restore → kind-guard on rentals & taxi_services (both correctly hide the field, taxi shows route, rental shows year/make/model instead).
rca of the issue: N/A — retest confirmed E1's fix works. EditModal now renders <F testid='edit-external-url'/> when !isRental && !isTaxi, and save payload uses (form.external_booking_url ?? '').trim() so an empty string reaches backend; backend ItemUpsert.model_dump(exclude_none=True) keeps '' and $set stores it, so the frontend truthiness guard on t.external_booking_url correctly hides the public link.
